metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the IGES 5.3 CLI tool in Node.js (stdlib-only) under `output/`:

- Entry point: `output/main.js` (runs as `node output/main.js <subcommand> ...`)
- Binary name: `output/iges` (node shebang wrapper)

Supports:
- `iges parse --input <file.iges> --output <out.json>`
- `iges write --input <file.json> --output <out.iges>`
- `iges query --input <file.iges> --de <odd> --output <entity.json>`
- `iges eval --input <file.iges> --de <odd> --t <f> [--s <f>] --output <point.json>`
- `iges roundtrip --input <file.iges> --output <out.iges>`

Key files:
- `output/lib/iges_parser.js` (fixed-format section parsing, Global/DE/PD parsing, validations + diagnostics)
- `output/lib/iges_writer.js` (deterministic 80-column writer, recomputes `param_data_ptr`/`param_line_count`, 1-line Terminate)
- `output/lib/entity_codecs.js` (87-entity catalog PD parse/write)
- `output/lib/eval.js` (parametric evaluation + DE transform application; numeric normals for surfaces)
- `output/lib/diagnostics.js` (spec-referenced diagnostic envelopes)
